title: Autonomous robotic system maps Bi2O3 synthesis phase diagram with active learning
summary: The SARA agent combined robotic laser spike annealing, optical characterization and nested active learning to map synthesis phase boundaries of Bi2O3. It reached orders-of-magnitude faster establishment of the phase diagram and identified conditions that stabilize metastable delta-Bi2O3. Validation is experimental but restricted to one oxide system.
ai_technology: Scientific Autonomous Reasoning Agent (SARA) with hierarchical active learning and uncertainty quantification
organization: Cornell University; University of Bern; California Institute of Technology

evidence.tested: The SARA system autonomously mapped Bi2O3 synthesis phase boundaries with robotic synthesis and optical characterization, and the phase diagram was established experimentally.
evidence.ai_role: Nested active learning cycles directed robotic laser spike annealing and optical characterization to map the phase diagram.
